title: CMU 9422 corn: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: CMU 9422 corn: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: CMU 9422 corn is an open pollinated corn variety for Luzon and Mindanao. About 100 days to harvest, 5.2 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits.
excerpt: CMU 9422 corn is an open pollinated corn variety. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council in 1997 as NSIC 1997 Cn 93. Central Mindanao University bred it. It takes about 100 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain, with 5.24 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

items: **Days to harvest:** about 100 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain.
**Yield:** 5.24 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.
**Recommended for:** Luzon and Mindanao, in the wet season.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

CMU 9422 corn takes about 100 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. That is about the average of the 10 open pollinated corn varieties with a day count, 102.7 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 5.24 t/ha trails the average of its group, 5.67. It sits in the lower quarter of its group. One tonne of shelled corn fills about 20 sacks of 50 kilograms. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in trials, rated under natural field conditions
rows: Took some damage but held up

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting. Read up on [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [Corn rust](/diseases/corn-rust), [Corn stalk rot](/diseases/corn-stalk-rot), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm).

The pests and diseases that hit corn fields most often: [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [banded leaf and sheath blight](/diseases/banded-leaf-and-sheath-blight), [Corn downy mildew](/diseases/corn-downy-mildew), [Corn ear rot](/diseases/corn-ear-rot), [Corn planthopper](/pests/corn-planthopper). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Where and when to plant CMU 9422 corn

It is recommended for Luzon and Mindanao in the wet season. Start with the color your buyer pays for: yellow corn goes to feed mills, while white and glutinous corn go to the table. Next, pick between a hybrid, which yields more but needs new seed every season, and an open pollinated variety, whose seed you can save. Then match the island group in its recommendation, because trials in Luzon and Mindanao give different winners. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for corn](/land-preparation/corn-land-preparation).

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes about 100 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 5.24 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.
Yes. It is open pollinated, so seed from a clean, isolated field grows true. Still, certified seed gives the best start every few seasons.
It is recommended for Luzon and Mindanao in the wet season. Ask your municipal agriculturist how it has done in your town.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of CMU 9422?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
